story.fullStory:
Night Ranger's "Sister Christian" reached #5 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Sister Christian" is a song by the American band Night Ranger.

A power ballad, it was released in March 1984 as the second single from their second album Midnight Madness (1983).

It was written and sung by the band's drummer, Kelly Keagy, for his sister.

The song peaked at #5 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 24 weeks on the chart.

A power ballad, it was released in March 1984 as the second single from their second album Midnight Madness (1983).
It was written and sung by the band's drummer, Kelly Keagy, for his sister.
The song peaked at #5 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 24 weeks on the chart.
Midnight Madness is the second studio album by American rock band Night Ranger, released in October 1983 by MCA Records.
The album produced three charting singles and contains the band's best known hit, "Sister Christian".
It remains their highest selling album at over a million copies sold in the US.
